title: The Dark Truth About SCP Foundation #Shorts
description:
The cold light on SCP Foundation leaves the facts intact and only the comfort removed. The SCP Foundation is a fictional secret organization and the premise of the SCP Wiki, a wiki-based collaborative fiction project launched in 2008. Within the project's shared world, the SCP Foundation is responsible for capturing, containing, and studying paranormal, supernatural, and other mysterious phenomena (known as "anomalies" or "SCPs"), while also keeping their existence hidden from society.

What looks like free choice in SCP Foundation is older than choice itself. The wiki is moderated by staff teams; each team is responsible for a different function such as community outreach and discipline. Wikidot users are required to submit an application before they are allowed to post content.

Source: Wikipedia (CC BY-SA 4.0). Made with AI assistance.
